v.rationale: All three share a near-identical shape (invokable controller, FormRequest after() hook with match(true), pricing class, DiscountType enum, #[Fillable]). Differences come down to edge-case correctness. impl-1 is the most complete: race-safe usage claiming, explicit 422 for no-matching-category, bounded fixed spreading; its bugs are minor (bad message on empty cart, re-applying own last-use code 422s). impl-2 is the cleanest and simplest with the best collection idioms and tests, but its one-sided uppercase normalisation makes any lowercase-stored code unusable, and it silently returns 0 discount for category mismatch. impl-3 has a genuine pricing bug — the fixed-discount remainder can push a line's discounted price negative — plus the same empty-cart message bug, which its own test enshrines, so it ranks last.
